mechanism: Any causal public diagonal phase correction before full covariant readout can be compiled into an invertible classical record relabeling. A prescribed fixed-trine orbit can instead be filtered from covariant records with exact input-independent probability3/q^2 and fully charged source shortage.
research_decision: Do not mistake nonlinear or outcome-adaptive diagonal feedback before FULL covariant measurement for additional quantum information. Preserve fixed-trine and batch-label-dependent readout as different access models unless their source emulation costs are actually met.
falsifiers: The physical covariant effect identity fails on an arbitrary input.
A causal transcript cannot recover every original raw record and its exact posterior.
A fixed-trine orbit has input-dependent acceptance or the wrong conditional Born law.
The emulator retries an already consumed ancestor, silently normalizes an incomplete stream, or uses a current outcome to select its orbit.

proof_obligations.PO-REVIEW: Independently review the causal transcript coupling, scaled-identity orbit effect and stopped fresh-source label law.
proof_obligations.PO-INPUT: A covariant-record source still requires the actual quantum data. No classical simulator for original DCP inputs, unknown states or their preparation inverse is supplied.
proof_obligations.PO-CAUSAL: Phases use public labels and earlier reports, never current/future outcomes or unknown secret. Arbitrary callback closures are not accepted as audited public policies.
proof_obligations.PO-READOUT: Full-covariant feedback equivalence does not cover arbitrary non-diagonal gates, collective measurements or retained quantum memory.
proof_obligations.PO-CAP: Fixed-trine emulation consumes q^2/3 raw covariant records on average per output and can fail under a cap. Every rejected record is consumed; IDs alone do not prove a fresh source.
proof_obligations.PO-REGIME: q^2 overhead is polynomial in q, not logq. In q=poly(n) it may be polynomial only if upstream source supply permits. Do not assert universal exponential cost or free simulation.
proof_obligations.PO-LOOKAHEAD: The fixed-trine resampling reduction covers one-pass current-label/past-output policies, not a basis chosen from the entire eventual accepted batch. Label matching and whole-batch postselection are not free.
proof_obligations.PO-DECODER: An efficient decoder of quantum-produced raw records could still be a major quantum algorithm. Feedback compilation does not solve that inference problem.
proof_obligations.PO-NOVELTY: This is an access/equivalence baseline with no novelty or speedup claim.
